headline: Cal State Monterey Bay fall, Cal State LA stay perfect
dek: Cal State Monterey Bay's unbeaten start ended on the road at Point Loma, leaving Cal State LA as the only side in the conference still winning every match. They won at Westmont the same day, a fifth win in five, and have yet to concede a goal.
displaced_by: Cal State Monterey Bay's first defeat, at Point Loma; Cal State LA now five from five and still unbreached

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific's 24 goals are more than Cal State Monterey Bay and Menlo have scored together, and nine different players have shared them.

wire.line: Cal State East Bay have conceded twenty-three goals and are the only side in the conference still without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result recorded, the earliest on the season's opening day and the latest in August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State Monterey Bay lost for the first time at Point Loma, but their seventeen goals are still more than any programme's except Fresno Pacific's.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UC Merced's win at Jessup was their first of the season, after three draws, and they remain unbeaten.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State San Bernardino have won three and drawn two, and have conceded two goals across them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zion Vaughn has scored seven goals from fifteen shots for Fresno Pacific.

last_match.line: Cal State Monterey Bay had won every match before this one; Point Loma had already beaten Cal Poly Pomona and drawn with Cal State San Bernardino and Cal State Dominguez Hills.

next_match.line: Texas A&M International arrive from a win at Cal State Dominguez Hills; Cal State San Bernardino have yet to lose.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
